digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport / retry handling
propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limiting (enabled per-admin, token-bucket model, introduced 8.6) sends 429 responses that rebar's DC transport does not honour, causing hard failures on first occurrence instead of respecting Retry-After headers

429 retries cannot route through _with_connection_retry (the single choke point for all 15 transport call sites including create_issue) because a 429 arriving after server-side write-begin is indistinguishable from gate rejection, risking duplicate-issue failures
429 retry policy must scope to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF, so future mutations cannot inherit retry by omission

Retry-After handling reuses existing _errors.parse_retry_after and MAX_BACKOFF_S, applies jitter-then-clamp arithmetic with 20% jitter and 60-second cap, and reads from exc.response.headers not exc.headers to avoid silent failures

This parent ticket decomposes the work into two children: S1 (extract retry/error cluster from transport.py into adapters/jira_datacenter/retry.py, forced by 789/800 line cap) and S2 (add 429 policy in extracted module with per-call read-only opt-in), with S2 depending on S1
